description_en: Adds tags to cloud resources which are Resource Access Management (RAM) roles and policies
description_zh: 调用TagResources为云资源（RAM角色、权限策略）创建并绑定标签
kebab_example: aliyun ram tag-resources --resource-type role --resource-names role1 --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: TagResources

parameters.help_en:
The resource type.

Enumerated values:

role: RAM roles.

policy: policies
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en: The names of the resources. You can specify up to 50 resource names
parameters.help_zh: 资源名称列表，一次最多支持输入50个资源名称
parameters.name: resource_names

fields.help_en: The key of the tag. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The value of the tag. The tag value can be up to 256 characters in length
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。一次最多支持输入20个标签
parameters.name: tag
